reasoning_summary: The model learned rapidly and MLM continued improving through step500, but the small fixed ranker suite saturated by step250 while score margins kept growing. This makes another identical training segment lower-value than evaluating the 255 untouched teacher-dev rows with candidate-order rotation. ALIGN-01 is a targeted repair signal, not a restart signal.
next_test: evaluate all 255 governed dev scenarios at step250 and step500; compare top1, separation, order invariance, margin distribution, and score magnitude
continuation_rule: choose the stronger checkpoint after dev challenge, then author hard-negative/cross-competency evaluation and repair only observed failures; never restart healthy native weights without concrete invalidation
